title: Progress of Rolling Out 5G Network in Singapore
what_it_is: Progress of Rolling Out 5G Network in Singapore

sections.label: 5G network rollout progress
sections.summary: The Minister says 5G rollout is planned to commence by 2020, IMDA launched a public consultation, and secure 5G use-cases are being developed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Communications and Information what is the progress of rolling out a 5G network in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: I announced at the Committee of Supply debates earlier this year that we plan to commence the rollout of 5G mobile networks by 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: We are on track to achieve this target.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Today, the Info-communications Media Development Authority (IMDA) launched a public consultation on the appropriate regulatory framework, spectrum allocation and other policies associated with 5G.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: To further differentiate Singapore’s 5G strategy, we also aim to advance innovation in secure 5G applications and services in tandem with our 5G network deployment process.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: One important aspect of this is developing key 5G use-cases, especially for enterprise applications, that we can potentially export to the rest of the world.

sections.label: 5G infrastructure by telcos
sections.summary: IMDA will eventually call for proposals, and private sector telcos, as IMDA licensees, will own and deploy the infrastructure.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: IMDA, on behalf of the Government, will eventually call for proposals.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The infrastructure itself, as with 3G and 4G, will be owned and deployed by private sector companies, in other words, the telcos, who are licensees of IMDA.

sections.label: Fourth mobile telco operator
sections.summary: An exercise concluded a few years back brought in a fourth mobile telco operator.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The Member would be aware that we concluded an exercise a few years back which brought in a fourth mobile telco operator.
